transcript.text: Hi everyone! So, as you all know, we're doing Aunt June's retirement brunch this Sunday at the Oak Street community hall, with about twenty-five guests expected to eat around 12:30. The hall has a kitchen and folding tables we can use. Before I finalize the food and serving plan, I want to go around and hear from each of you — anything I should know that might shape the final plan? Dietary needs, timing concerns, serving ideas, whatever you've got. Let's hear it!
